description: This file contains functions for filename manipulation, specifically 'gitbasename' and 'gitdirname', adapted from libiberty's basename.c, used within the Git project for handling path components.

methods.name: char * gitbasename(char * path)
methods.description: Returns the basename of a given path, similar to the POSIX basename but with specific handling for DOS drive prefixes and returning '.' for invalid input.

methods.name: char * gitdirname(char * path)
methods.description: Returns the directory name component of a given path, with special handling for POSIX directory semantics and DOS drive prefixes.
